<title level="2" right="Creature 20">[Speaker Of Svarýr](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2592)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="CN" url="/Rules.aspx?ID=95" />
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Fey" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=69" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #192: Worst of All Possible Worlds](/Sources.aspx?ID=203) pg. 46

**Perception** +34; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12), [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=33) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 60 feet

**Languages**
[Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Sylvan](/Languages.aspx?ID=10); [_speak with plants_](/Spells.aspx?ID=294), [_tongues_](/Spells.aspx?ID=340)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +34, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +34, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +36, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +38, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +36, [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) +34

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +6

**Dex** +6

**Con** +5

**Int** +4

**Wis** +6

**Cha** +8
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 44 

**Fort** +31 

**Ref** +36 

**Will** +33 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 380

, regeneration 30 (deactivated by [acid](/Traits.aspx?ID=3) or [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72))

</row>

**Weaknesses**
[cold iron](/Equipment.aspx?ID=375) 20, fire 20

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 30 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
fist +36 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [versatile S](/Traits.aspx?ID=200)),
**Damage** 4d10+14 bludgeoning plus 2d8 mental

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
tail +36 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Backswing](/Traits.aspx?ID=173)),
**Damage** 4d6+14 bludgeoning plus 2d10 mental and Befuddling Lash

**Primal Innate Spells** DC 42, attack +34
- **Cantrips (10th)**
[Light](/Spells.aspx?ID=171), [Guidance](/Spells.aspx?ID=142), [Produce Flame](/Spells.aspx?ID=236), [Tanglefoot](/Spells.aspx?ID=330)
- **6th**
[Chain Lightning](/Spells.aspx?ID=33) (×3), [Slow](/Spells.aspx?ID=289)
- **7th**
[Cloudkill](/Spells.aspx?ID=42), [Fly](/Spells.aspx?ID=125), [Heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148)
- **8th**
[Heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148), [Mask of Terror](/Spells.aspx?ID=185)
- **9th**
[Disjunction](/Spells.aspx?ID=77), [Heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148)
- **10th**
[Chain Lightning](/Spells.aspx?ID=33), [Heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148)
- **Constant (10th)**
[Speak with Plants](/Spells.aspx?ID=294), [Tongues](/Spells.aspx?ID=340)

**Befuddling Lash**  ([Curse](/Traits.aspx?ID=38), [Enchantment](/Traits.aspx?ID=61), [Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) When the Speaker damages a creature with her tail, a wave of befuddlement clouds the target's thoughts. The creature must succeed at a DC 42 Will save or become [stupefied 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=37) (stupefied 2 on a critical failure) for 1 minute.

**Manipulate Luck** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Curse](/Traits.aspx?ID=38), [Primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=134)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The huldra touches another creature to manipulate the creature's luck. The creature must attempt a DC 42 Will save. On a failure, the huldra chooses good luck or bad luck. If the huldra chooses good luck, the affected creature can roll twice on one d20 roll within the next minute and use the higher result; this is a [fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=76) effect. If the huldra chooses bad luck, the creature must roll twice and use the lower result on its next d20 roll; this is a [misfortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=110) effect.

</column>
